description: Defines PythonSymNodeImpl class and related functions for integrating Python objects with C++ SymNode API in PyTorch, including type checks, wrappers, and dispatch methods.

classes.name: PythonSymNodeImpl
classes.description: Adapter class that wraps a Python object to implement c10::SymNodeImpl interface, enabling Python-C++ interoperability for symbolic nodes.

methods.name: is_symint
methods.description: Checks if a Python handle is an instance of the symbolic integer class.

methods.name: is_symfloat
methods.description: Checks if a Python handle is an instance of the symbolic float class.

methods.name: is_symbool
methods.description: Checks if a Python handle is an instance of the symbolic boolean class.

methods.name: is_dynint
methods.description: Checks if a Python handle is an instance of the dynamic integer class.
